source.quote: a PR body that merely mentioned `#363` would have relabelled that package cell:merged. Both sync-cells.sh and fleet's reap now require the issue reference in the PR title or a closing keyword in the body.

prompt: Write claims.js in the current directory, exporting claims(pr, n) with CommonJS. pr is {title, body}; n is an issue number. Return true only when the title references #n (not as a prefix of a longer number such as #3630) or the body has a closing keyword (close, closes, closed, fix, fixes, fixed, resolve, resolves, resolved; case-insensitive) followed by #n. A body that merely mentions #n elsewhere does not claim it. Reply with the single word done.

checks.name: a passing mention does not claim
a longer number does not claim
